svg.title: Yellow Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-an-installation-seven-new-paintings-10-1996/lightbox/works/yellow-panel-1996-3728; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
